dedupe_keys.name: giga digital repository curated tools reports and data platforms on school connectivity

description: The Giga Digital Repository is a curated web catalogue of tools, reports, data platforms and guidance on connecting schools to the internet, organised by stage of the connectivity journey: planning, preparation, implementation, utilisation, policy and governance, and data repositories. Entries include the ITU infrastructure connectivity map (BBmaps), ITU Data Hub, UNICEF data on remote learning and home internet access, the OECD broadband statistics portal, ITU reports on ICT development and prices, the ITU connectivity planning platform (marked as coming soon), and OECD papers on broadband financing. Producer: Giga, a joint initiative of UNICEF and ITU; it also runs the Giga Learning Hub. Coverage: global. Access: free web page with links out to the listed resources. Licence and cost: free to read; no licence statement was read. Caveats: it is a link directory, not a dataset; each listed resource has its own terms and some are still announced only. Simulation uses: it helps analysts find infrastructure-mapping and cost-planning inputs for connectivity capacity planning. Related records: none linked; the individual ITU and OECD resources are catalogued separately where they exist.
